item.text:
{
  "name_a": "Snow-free terrain",
  "name_b": "Snow-covered terrain",
  "definition": "A patch lies closer to A when more of its land shows exposed tan or brown ground and less shows bright white or cyan snow cover. Patches closer to B have extensive snow interspersed with dark vegetation and terrain features.",
  "cues": [
    "B has extensive bright white to icy cyan areas in both composites; A largely lacks these.",
    "A has broad tan or brown ground surfaces in true color, turning greenish or turquoise in false color.",
    "B shows dark trees and wooded slopes contrasting sharply with bright snow; A shows trees against exposed earth."
  ],
  "visible": "high"
}
